cases.generation_prompt: Create a single contact sheet containing FOUR independent, original photorealistic synthetic municipal sewer CCTV camera frames for an educational software demo. Exact flush 2x2 grid with four equal landscape 16:9 quadrants. Overall image ratio 16:9. Each quadrant is a different plausible camera photograph filling the entire quadrant; no panel borders, whitespace or gaps. No labels, watermarks, writing, overlay, people, private location details or text. Nothing photographic is supplied as input. Muted authentic inspection-headlamp lighting, practical older camera color, modest sharpness, slight moist specular reflections. Four distinct camera positions and wall textures; each has a recognizable pipe bore or curved wall. Show FOUR DIFFERENT types of widespread gray concrete wall material degradation: top left: in older large cast concrete sewer pipe looking straight down barrel, pale powdery leached, corroded concrete and salt stains on the upper and BOTH sidewalls, rough aggregate exposed, muted sepia gray footage and puddle below. Top right: close sidewall view of acid-eroded concrete over much of a ring, mottled granular cream/white surface, washed-out gray and tan patch tapering toward intact material, dark opening diagonally right, no black fracture lines. Bottom left: a dark damp, brownish concrete sewer tube looking straight forward, broad blotched streaky brown areas and pocked, delaminated concrete around the entire barrel, inside-camera light reveals rough aggregate, deep bore black. Bottom right: rough porous whitish-gray concrete crown has progressively spalled and pitted with crumbling uneven grain and exposed aggregate on a much smoother dark gray wall; angle from axial pipe CCTV, no longitudinal narrow crack, avoid structured brick or ribbed material. Use weathering rather than metal rust, no debris piles or openings on the side.

cases.generation_prompt: Create a single contact sheet containing FOUR independent, original photorealistic synthetic municipal sewer CCTV camera frames for an educational software demo. Exact flush 2x2 grid with four equal landscape 16:9 quadrants. Overall image ratio 16:9. Each quadrant is a different plausible camera photograph filling the entire quadrant; no panel borders, whitespace or gaps. No labels, watermarks, writing, overlay, people, private location details or text. Nothing photographic is supplied as input. Muted authentic inspection-headlamp lighting, practical older camera color, modest sharpness, slight moist specular reflections. Four distinct camera positions and wall textures; each has a recognizable pipe bore or curved wall. Every quadrant depicts a single coherent natural fictional pipe scene with two clearly separated visual features: a prominent, high-contrast jagged open longitudinal diagonal fracture with two or three branches on the center-right gray cement wall, AND a smaller but clearly localized piled-up sand/gravel/mud obstruction in lower-left foreground with water flowing around it. Give both high visibility: the fissure is about a third of the image in extent, with chipped lips and shadows. Avoid confusing it with an intact ring joint. Keep the deposit about the lower fifth to third of the frame, no heaps that hide the crack. Top-left: low forward camera, bore disappears leftward, strong uneven fracture and separate low tan gravel mound. Top-right: near forward-facing shot lit from camera, coarse pale concrete, dark open split and a smaller triangular mound along invert. Bottom left: side-on light, distinct large branching angular broken wall near center, mud and loose small stones confined to foreground lower left. Bottom right: near-frontal small storm drain, large branched fracture on the right face and clear wedge of light sandy sediment blocking lower left. Different realistic textures and tones for each. All cues must be on the same frame, do not split a single quadrant.
